rule: Each core witch has 1 interference slot holding TWO interference witches. Unlocked after clearing Story 2-3.
The two interference witches MUST be the same class as the core witch they support (Arcanist core -> 2 Arcanist interference, etc.).
Interference witches are NOT deployed; they 'activate Interference Skills from outside the battlefield', buffing the core witch.
A witch's Interference skill does NOT benefit her when she is a core member. It only applies when she occupies another core unit's support slot.
Class gate is necessary but not sufficient - the interference buff should match the core unit's needs (e.g. don't put a Physical-damage interference on a Magic core).
Every witch has TWO grades: CORE value (deployed kit) and INTERFERENCE value (off-field buff quality). Tier list must show both.
Team builder = 4 core slots + 2 class-locked interference sub-slots each. Class DEPTH matters (need same-class benchwarmers for interference).
Interference entries show a class-letter+number tag (A1/A2/A3 for Arcanist) - likely interference tier tied to the support witch's star/rank. To confirm.
